aria-expanded on trigger element (true when open)

componentDescriptions.Popover:
Overlay flotante anclado a un trigger. Placement: top, bottom, left, right. Sizes: sm(240) md(320) lg(480). Variants: default, info, warning, error, success. Scope de este build: modal=siempre, flecha=siempre visible.

🔑 ARIA:
• role="dialog" + aria-modal="true" (siempre — modal fijo en este scope)
• aria-labelledby → title id (cuando Has Title = true)
• aria-expanded + aria-controls en el trigger
• aria-haspopup="dialog" en el trigger

⌨️ Keyboard:
• Enter/Space en trigger: abre popover, foco al primer elemento
• Tab / Shift+Tab: ciclo circular dentro del popover (focus trap siempre activo)
• Escape: cierra + retorna foco al trigger

🎯 Focus:
• Al abrir: primer elemento focusable dentro
• Al cerrar: retornar foco al trigger que lo abrió
• Focus trap circular siempre activo (modal=true fijo)
• shouldFlip=true: arrow reorienta según placement real (la flecha siempre está visible)

Tokens: 22, prefijo pop-.
WCAG 2.2 AA · APG Dialog Pattern.

_decisions.why: Tooltip in this system uses 4 positions. 12 (Ant) and 20 (Spectrum) positions are excessive for Figma variant generation. Start/end alignment is a runtime layout concern, not a visual variant. 4 directions × 3 sizes × 5 variants = 60 frames (medium complexity).

_decisions.what: Variant: default | info | warning | error | success (no 'help')
_decisions.why: 0/5 popover systems use semantic variants on the container — but Zoom is enterprise and inline status popovers (e.g., field validation, contextual warnings) are common. 5 variants keep it useful without over-expanding. 'help' omitted — ContextualHelp is a composable BB, not a core variant.

_decisions.what: Arrow fixed always-visible (no toggle) — scope answer: 'siempre'
_decisions.why: User scope selected arrow=always for this build, so the Has Arrow boolean was removed; the arrow layer is permanently visible and not exposed in the Figma properties panel. Direction is still determined by Placement.

_decisions.what: Has Title and Has Footer as booleans (booleanTextPair + booleanLayer)
_decisions.why: Title and footer are optional slot regions that appear/hide without changing component structure. Binary toggle = boolean per global-property-rules. Has Title defaultVisible=true (most popovers have a title); Has Footer defaultVisible=false (footer is opt-in for action patterns).

_decisions.what: modal=true fijo (focus trap siempre activo) — scope answer: 'siempre'
_decisions.why: User scope selected modal=always for this build — covers help/confirmation/forms use cases under one consistent accessible behavior (Spectrum's always-modal approach). role="dialog" always; no role="tooltip" alt-path needed.

_decisions.what: Click as default trigger type (hover not recommended)
_decisions.why: Hover-only violates WCAG 1.4.13 for keyboard users. 4/5 systems use click as primary trigger. Ant Design's hover default is a documented a11y gap. If hover is used, focus must be a co-trigger.
